name: mailroom
description: Self-hosted, Resend-style email platform on Amazon SES on Cloudflare Workers.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: **Required.** The address Mailroom will live at: `https://<Worker name>.<your subdomain>.workers.dev` (your subdomain is under **Workers & Pages**, right side) or your own domain. The deploy stops while it's still `mailroom.example.com`.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: **Required.** Your email address (comma separated for more). Only these addresses, and people they invite, can sign in.

AWS_REGION.description: The Amazon SES region your AWS account sends from, e.g. `us-east-1`.

MAX_SEND_RATE.description: Your SES account's maximum send rate (emails per second): SES console › **Account dashboard**.

TIMEZONE.description: The IANA time zone the dashboard's days are counted in, e.g. `America/New_York`.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: A long random string that signs sessions and encrypts stored keys: `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it: changing it signs everyone out.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: The access key of the IAM user Mailroom uses (see the README's [Amazon SES setup](https://github.com/RVP97/mailroom#1-amazon-ses)).

SYSTEM_FROM.description: Optional. The sender of Mailroom's own emails (sign-in codes, invitations), on a domain onboarded in Cloudflare Email Sending, e.g. `Mailroom <no-reply@mail.example.com>`.

OPERATOR_NAME.description: Optional. Your name, shown on the public About, Privacy and Terms pages.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Optional. The contact address shown on those pages.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/deployment-config.mjs && vite build && node scripts/sentry-upload.mjs prepare && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy && node scripts/sentry-upload.mjs upload
